name: Puerto Rico
about: Hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: Old San Juan's colonial streets, El Yunque rainforest, and bioluminescent bays — a US territory needing no passport for US travelers.
costOverview: Coffee and rideshares are reasonable — a mofongo dinner and the tourist-zone markup push costs up from there.
